$comment: pi sandbox extension allowlist. Pins: sha256 = flat entry-file pin (siblings staged unverified); tree_sha256 = whole-directory pin (recursive, symlink/.git/node_modules rejected). The launcher stages the verified bytes and pi loads ONLY the staged copies. Refresh tree pins after changing the pinned source: node scripts/pi-sandbox-policy.mjs tree-hash packaging/pi/anvil-pi. CI fails on drift. See packaging/pi/sandbox/README.md.

unattended-exec.description: Unattended execution child: may read, edit, and drive the anvil state loop with the hash-pinned anvil-pi extension. Tool names cover built-ins AND the pinned extension's registered tools — pi's --tools allowlist filters extension tools by name too.

read-only-review.description: Fresh-context review child: read-only tools, no network, no write surface.
